podcast.body: In the late 1990s, Cher sold 11 billion copies of this album, which was noted for sounding like it could have fit in the 1970s. This success came after a period of career resurgence marked by her acting achievements. "she sold 11 billion copies of Believe in the late 90s, which sure sounds like it would be at home in the 70s to me."

podcast.body: One of Cher's best-selling albums from the 1990s is noted for its voluntary and complete saturation with Auto-Tune throughout the entire record. This demonstrates that the intentional use of Auto-Tune, often criticized in trap music, is a long-standing artistic choice by established artists. "uno de los discos más vendidos de la época de los 90 que es un disco de Cher que el disco entero está saturado de auto-tium de manera completamente voluntaria."
